entries.description: MCP server providing exact geometry calculations based on constructive formulas grounded in first-principles, delivering more accurate results than traditional approximations for real-world applications in engineering, navigation, and analysis, as validated through physical measurements.
entries.disambiguatingDescription: A self-contained geometric framework grounded in constructive mathematics and physical equivalence, offering precise alternatives to traditional analytic geometry for superior real-world accuracy.
